title: Woosung & Hankow Chinese Pilots Association Attempts To

page_data.en:
Copy for D.C. & P.R.
B. REGISTER
4449
1/2/33

"A."
Central
January 30, 33.

Mins. 22/33.

At 10 a.m. on the 30-1-33, E. B. Moller of Moller
& Company, 12 the Bund, accompanied a pilot named Chang
Sue Cheng employed by G. Moller & Company to this Sta-
tion and reported that the newly formed Woosung & Hankow
Licensed Pilots Associated of 38 Seking Road were attempt-
ing to force Chang Sue Ching to become a member of that
"Union". Enquiries by D.S. Darvill learned that Chang
Sue Ching had been approached by Yang Hong Sung, manager
of the Association and residing at No. 11 Passage No.
1553 Rue LaTour to become a member on the 12-1-33. Chang
promised to join but, under-took a voyage on behalf of
Moller & Company before actually becoming a member and
he returned from this voyage on 26-1-33. On arrival
at Woosung he was accosted by Yang Hong Sung and other
members of the Union and escorted to 38 Seking Road where
he was compelled to sign a note in which he promised
to pay the pilots fee of $40.00 to the Union and also
a fine of $100.00 for acting for Moller & Company in
contravention. There were also threats that if he did not
comply with the demands of the Union he would be prevented
from working. The matter is being investigated.

B. 登记簿
4449
1933年2月1日

“A.”
中央捕房
1933年1月30日。

会议记录 22/33。

1933年1月30日上午10时，外滩12号马勒公司（Moller & Company）的 E. B. 马勒（E. B. Moller）陪同一名由 G. 马勒公司（G. Moller & Company）雇用的名为张树成（Chang Sue Cheng，音译）的引水员来到本捕房，并报告称，新成立的位于西京路38号的吴淞汉口持证引水员联合会（Woosung & Hankow Licensed Pilots Associated）正试图强迫张树成加入该“工会”。副巡官达维尔（D.S. Darvill）经查询获悉，该联合会经理杨洪松（Yang Hong Sung，音译），居住于拉都路（Rue LaTour）1553弄11号，曾于1933年1月12日接触张树成，要求其入会。张当时答应加入，但在正式入会前代表马勒公司出航一次，并于1933年1月26日返航。抵达吴淞后，他遭到杨洪松及其他工会成员的拦阻，并被押送至西京路38号，在那里被迫签署一张字据，承诺向工会支付引水费40.00元，以及因违规为马勒公司服务而罚款100.00元。此外还受到威胁，若不遵从工会要求，将阻止其工作。此事正在调查中。
